purpose: The claims required for the November 2026 candidate set from 12 November 2026: one component claim per role under native-baseline@2, the one baseline a claim names, whose rows are exactly the baseline's requires list for the role, and gs1-identifier-discipline and profile-governance, which guard live records. Every other claim the selection names is withheld, each with its reason: a claim scoped to the historical native-baseline@1, the proposed native-baseline@3, or an optional profile or governance condition this release does not claim.

notes: The qualification of this selection says which claims the ledger's evidence supports for the packages of the candidate set. It is not a statement about the deployed index, the registry runtime, the application, product compliance or any European standard.
